turns.responseText:
CRO Submission Export — WuXi AppTec (BCR-ABL1 Campaign) — Validates cardiac safety, computes physicochemical properties, and formats all 5 ranked compounds into a WuXi-ready submission CSV.

Input: 5 compounds with SMILES, IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), and composite scores — Asciminib (#1), Bosutinib (#2), Imatinib (#3), Gleevec-analog-2 (#4), Gleevec-analog-1 (#5)
Key steps:

hERG safety validation → flags any compound with hERG IC50 ≤ 1 μM as cardiac-unsafe (all 5 must pass)
RDKit MW/LogP computation → appends physicochemical descriptors to compound records
WuXi AppTec column formatter → exports wuxiapptec_submission.csv with standardized fields (compound_id, SMILES, IC50_nM, hERG_IC50_uM, composite_score, MW, LogP)


Expected output: wuxiapptec_submission.csv (5-compound ranked table, WuXi-ready) + submission_metadata.json (campaign summary, safety gate status, export timestamp)

Decision gate: All 5 compounds must clear hERG IC50 > 1 μM before export is finalized — any compound failing this threshold will be flagged and excluded from the submission package automatically.
Required inputs

Input data files (e.g., structures/SMILES, assay data, or concentration-time table)
Basic study metadata (condition, units, and endpoint definitions)

Next step

Confirm the intended analysis priority and upload the required inputs so I can produce a runnable, decision-ready workflow.
